name: guest-start-denied
description: The DENY half of the guest session-start gate. Same parked create as guest-start-approved — the unstamped sender on an org-scoped channel is a guest with no start_session — but the platform admin clicks Deny: decideStartApproval writes the denied relation and the StartFailure signal, and the operator drives the session to Failed/StartDenied without a runner ever existing. The single LLM step is a canary that must never fire — if the session ran at all, the phase barrier (Failed, checked by name in wantSessionPhaseFor) would land on Idle instead and the run would diverge.

reply.text: THIS MUST NEVER RUN: a denied guest session must not reach the model.
